name: Verit Maaazitor

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Verit Maalazitor may use Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Herald of Ruin
bonuses.text: At the start of each round Verit Maalazitor is alive, the GM gains a point of ruin for every 6 Cultists alive in the Scene.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: Verit Maalazitor has a Mark of Chaos (Undivided)

bonuses.name: Priest of the Dark Gods
bonuses.text: Verit Maalazitor gains +2 bonus dice to all Interaction Attacks.

abilities.name: Kneel Before the Dark Gods!
abilities.text: As an action Verit Maalazitor makes an Interaction Attack against all targets within 15m who do not possess the <CHAOS> Keyword. Any target affected by the Interaction Attack is Prone in addition to the normal effects.

abilities.name: Faithful Flock
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. All allies with the <CHAOS> Keyword within 10 metres gain +2 bonus dice to Weapon Skill (I) Tests until the start of this Threat's next turn.

note: Heading prints 'MAAAZITOR'; the text and the contents tab print 'Maalazitor'.
